1. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the bankruptcy documents are proofs of claim forms;
automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations and include supporting documentation specific to each creditor's debt claim; and
batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations on behalf of the creditors.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different courts with different filing system configurations, and wherein the method further comprises transforming the data records into court-specific formats compatible with each court's electronic filing requirements.

6. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim;
automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records by transforming the data records into court-specific proof of claim documents, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations and include creditor-specific supporting documentation;
validating each proof of claim against the filing requirements of the target bankruptcy organization; and
batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations on behalf of the creditors.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations, and wherein the proofs of claims are automatically formatted according to each court's specific filing requirements.

8. (Original) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages notify the creditors that various debtors have filed for bankruptcy.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using a secure file transfer protocol and storing the requests in a centralized database before processing.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via a Web site and authenticating each creditor before accepting the requests.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 where batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode at least once per day, wherein the batch filing is performed automatically without manual intervention by a user.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising:
generating a report that tracks the status of filed proofs of claims; and
sending the report to a particular creditor via electronic transmission.

13. (Original) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using a Web site.

14. (Original) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed.

15. (Original) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer without requiring manual filing by individual creditors.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record against a set of predefined validation rules specific to the target bankruptcy organization.
